item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang rgyud mchog gi bsnyen sgrub phyag bzhes 'phrul gyi lde mig
item.coloph: zhes che mchog dran pa yang gsang gi phyag bzhes 'phrul gyi lde mig ces bya ba 'di/ bslab pa gsum ldan gyi btsun pa phun tshogs ye shes sogs/ sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa'i grwa rigs 'gas bskul ba dang / rang 'dra blo rmongs rnams kyi 'jug bde ba'i phyir du/ sprul pa'i sku mchog rnam gsum gyi bka' lung dang*/ mtshungs med rig 'dzin kun grol grags pa rin po che'i gsang sngags gsang ba'i phyag bzhes rnams la gtsor bzhag cing*/ che mchog dran pa yang gsang gi rgyud don la nye bar brtson pa'i btsun pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan 'bod pa de'i (des) / 'dus gnas rin chen 'bar ba'i yang dben kun grags mthong grol ri khrod du/ lha mchog gang de sgrab pa'i thun mtshams su/ chu byi zla tshes bzang por sbyar ba'i (bas/)yi ge pa ni gsungs rab bris kyi rig pa 'dzin pa/ skal bzang bstan 'dzin gyi (gyis) byas pa dge legs su gyur cig/
